cohort: The study included 187 preterm neonates with a gestational age of 34 weeks or less.
finding: The homozygous GG rs4963506 and GG rs12270961 variants of CC16 were significantly associated with an increased risk of Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) in preterm neonates, but no association was found between any CC16 polymorphisms and Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia (BPD).
